topic: The vow of celibacy should be abandoned

node_results.node_text: Clergy who are married or have families may better understand the challenges faced by their congregations, such as balancing work, family, and faith.

argument_results.matched_argument: priests would be much happier without the constraints of celibacy, as family people they would be better able to understand and help the people in their church, they could relate to them better.

node_results.node_text: Abandoning it could be perceived as eroding core religious identity and undermining centuries of tradition.

argument_results.matched_argument: it is a vow that has been a long held tradition in the church and shouldn't be changed
it is the bedrock of catholisism that priests are celibate and to abandon this would be expecting catholics to rethink or abandon their beliefs to their detriment.
the teachings of the catholic church go back centuries and celibacy is one of the fundamentals that cannot just be abandoned without harming the whole concept of catholisism.
The vow of celibacy is a deeply rooted tradition and would further tear down  the church and all it stands for.
the vow of celibacy must be kept in order for the church to remain faithful to tradition.  otherwise it is no longer the same religion.
The vow of celibacy should not be abandoned as religious people have lived this way for a long time and their traditions should be respected.
the vow of celibacy should not be abandoned because it is a centuries old practice that is considered sacred and holy.
we should not abandon the vow of celibacy because it is a centuries old custom that is seen as sacred and holy.
